title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at 64,916 dollars with a 0.4 percent gain as fear dominates sentiment at a 30 reading. US morning action delivered little conviction despite the modest move higher.

Hashrate remains elevated at 919.6 EH/s, confirming sustained miner commitment. The mempool shows 92,672 pending transactions with fees at 3 sat/vB, reflecting congestion without bidding pressure. Block height now sits at 959,866.

No material news broke during the session.
